jobs.description: Wir suchen talentierte Kfz-Techniker für Teslas Service Center in Hamburg. Bei Tesla sind unsere Techniker das Rückgrat des Servicebetriebs und unterstützen unsere Mission, den weltweiten Übergang zu nachhaltiger Energie zu beschleunigen. Wir haben eines der innovativsten Fahrzeuge aller Zeiten entwickelt, und als Servicetechnikerin trägst du dazu bei, unserer Kundschaft einen ebenso innovativen Service zu bieten.Wir bieten:- Karriereentwicklung und Weiterbildung: Bei Tesla hast du die Möglichkeit zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung durch regelmäßige Performance Reviews, gezielte Trainingsmaßnahmen und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (z.B. Hochvoltschulungen, Managementtrainings) - Unternehmenskultur: Tauche ein in unsere inspirierende Unternehmenskultur, in der Innovation, Teamwork und Leidenschaft im Mittelpunkt stehen - Innovative Projekte und Technologien: Du hast die Chance, an wegweisenden Projekten und Technologien zu arbeiten, die die Zukunft der Automobilindustrie und nachhaltiger Energie mitgestalten - Vorteile und Zusatzleistungen: Dich erwartet ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket, das neben Tesla Aktien oder einem CashAward auch den Zugang zu unserem Corporate Benefits Programm, 30 Tage Urlaub, ein 13. Du kannst im Schichtdienst arbeiten, um dein Team zu unterstützen. Das kann Wochenenden sowie Morgen- und Abendschichten umfassen (bei einer 5-Tage Woche) - Fahrerlaubnis: Du besitzt einen gültigen EU-Führerschein der Klasse B - Berechtigung: Du besitzt eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für DeutschlandENGLISH VERSIONPlease note that experience or training in the automotive sector is crucial for the recognition of your qualifications. Therefore, while we can initiate the recruiting process immediately, we can only issue a final employment contract once the recognition of your vocational training in Germany is fully completed.Further information can be found at: https://www.anerkennung-in-deutschland.de/html/en/getting-recognition.phpWe are looking for talented Automotive Technicians for Tesla's Service Centers. Above-average salary• 13th-month salary• Choice between Tesla stock or a cash bonus• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (opportunity to purchase Tesla stock at a discounted price)• Permanent employment contract• Saturday work allowance of 25%• Company pension scheme• Life insurance• Occupational disability insurance• Accident insurance for business travel• Further insurance discounts• Bonuses for successful employee referralsDiscounts and Recognition• Tesla apparel and workwear (incl. laptop for work)• Exclusive corporate benefits• Discount in the Tesla Online Shop• Upgrade option to “Full Self-Driving Capability”Health and Wellbeing• Choice between a discounted Urban Sports Club membership or a wellness allowance• 30 days of vacation• Special leave for events such as moving, marriage, or bereavement• Employee Assistance Program “Fürstenberg” (free, confidential support for personal or professional challenges)• Company doctor, medical checks, and consultations• Additional personal work equipment (e.g., computer glasses)• Free drinks and fruit• Overtime meals/cateringMobility and Transport• Subsidized “Deutschland-Job-Ticket”• Next Bike rental discounts• Job Bike leasing (tax-advantaged)Learning and Development• Online learning platform• Internal training programs (including topics such as high-voltage training and leadership training)• Onboarding in Berlin• Regular feedback sessions and performance reviewsWhat You’ll DoYou will- Service, repair and improve: Working with Tesla specific software and advanced tools you will be performing repairs and maintenance on jobs.description: Plausity is an AI-native due diligence platform for MundA advisors, private equity and VC funds, and corporate development teams, built in Hamburg. Lead live due diligence for private equity and advisory clients on the Plausity platform, and turn what you learn on each deal into a better product.The role at a glance- Title: Engagement Manager Due Diligence (m/f/d)- Focus: DD on PE and MundA transactions- Experience: 1+ years in diligence consulting, PE or transaction advisory- Contract: Permanent, full-time- Location: Hamburg / hybrid- Languages: English fluent- Compensation: Base + performance bonus + equity / VSOP / ESOPWhy this role- You have run enough diligences to know how much of the work is admin: reading data rooms, chasing evidence, formatting findings. At Plausity you run deals without that overhead, and you decide how the next thousand diligences will be run.- Senior from day one. You work directly with the founders and present to deal teams yourself.- Deal work and product work in one job. What slows you down on Monday s project goes to engineering on Tuesday.- An early seat. You join while the practice, the playbooks and the team are still being shaped, with equity to match.About Plausity- Plausity is an AI-powered due diligence platform for MundA, private equity, Family Offices, sell side and advisory teams. One workspace covers the full workflow: data room ingestion, document analysis, evidence gap detection, findings and risk intelligence, collaboration, and the first draft of reports and IC memos.- The platform supports commercial, value creation, financial, legal, tax, tech, cybersecurity, ESG and AI impact diligence, among others. Our clients are buy-side and sell-side teams: PE and VC funds, MundA advisors, Family Offices, consultancies, law firms, lenders and corporates. One Big Four advisory practice reports cutting a mid-market commercial DD from 8 weeks to 2 days with Plausity.- We believe diligence stays an expert s job. The platform handles volume and evidence; people like you supply judgment. Our line for it:  Less admin. Sharper judgment. Faster deals.What you will do   Deliver diligence (about 60%)- Lead day-to-day execution of commercial and AI due diligence projects on the Plausity platform, from kick-off to final report.- Structure the key questions, build the workplan and own the core workstreams: e.g. market sizing, competitive landscape, customer research, industry experts, business plan review, financial modeling and AI/tech assessment.- Use the platform end to end: e.g. data room analysis, evidence gap detection, findings, primary research, cyber security DD and AI expert interviews.- Turn analysis into a clear, investment-grade storyline and present it to deal teams and investment committees.- Check every AI-generated finding against its source. You sign off on the quality of what the client receives.What you will do   Shape the product (about 20%)- Work side by side with our engineers. Translate what you see on live deals into workflows, prompts, templates and features.- Build reusable assets, such as sector playbooks, question trees and report structures, so each project runs faster than the last.- Help define what good commercial and AI diligence looks like inside the platform.What you will do   Grow the business (about 20%)- Onboard client deal teams and help them run their first diligences on Plausity.- Scope projects, contribute to proposals and join pitches and demos for funds and advisory firms.- Build relationships with PE funds, MundA advisors and corporate finance teams.- Contribute to thought leadership: sector notes, whitepapers and LinkedIn content.What success looks like- After 3 months: you have won first clients, led your first projects on the platform and delivered them on deadline to a standard clients come back for.- After 6 months: your playbooks are in use on every commercial DD, and

jobs.occupation: Customer Solution Manager (m/f/d) (Key-Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Job Req Number: 131736Arbeitszeitmodel: VollzeitDivision: DEU - Schenker Deutschland AG (Road)Standort: HamburgWe are actively searching for a Customer Solution Manager, Road Control Tower (m/f/d) the position can be based in one of our Road Transport Control Towers across Germany, the Netherlands or Poland.Your Benefits*- Financial Benefits: Capital-forming benefits, company pension scheme, employee discounts, DSV employee card with a monthly net credit, job bike, anniversary payments- Health and Mobility: Supplementary health insurance (depending on division), screen work glasses, group accident insurance- Onboarding: Extensive onboarding with an individual training plan- Team: A great, dedicated, and motivated team, flat organizational structures, and an open working atmosphere- Variety: A diverse range of tasks with significant decision-making freedom at a global player- Flexibility: A modern workplace including a transparent flexitime policy.- Development: Regular training and development programs, e‑learning offerings, and initiatives such as Talents@DSV to keep your skills up to date. Tailored development programs are also possible.Job Purpose:“You can make the difference in the partnership between the customer and DSV.”Bérke Seelen, Senior Manager, European Road Control TowerShape solutions that move our customers forward:As a Customer Solution Manager in DSV’s Road Control Tower, you are at the centre of the relationship between our customers and our organisation. You bring people together across operations, commercial teams and markets to solve complex challenges, strengthen performance and turn agreements into solutions that work in practice.Working across customer management, Road operations and solution development, you will be close to the decisions that matter. You will turn customer requirements and performance insights into practical improvements, bringing colleagues and customers together to deliver results across internal markets.Be the connection that brings customer, commercial, operations and IT together....As the strategic link between the customer and DSV, you oversee performance, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure that commercial agreements become effective and scalable logistics solutions. You know your customers well enough to anticipate what they need next.You will work with your customers from every angle, and no two customer challenges are quite the same. You may be working with operations on performance, bringing IT into a new implementation, supporting a commercial opportunity or designing a customer-specific solution. The breadth of the role gives you a 360-degree view of the customer and a wide network across DSV.Key Responsibilities:In this role, you will:- Act as the Control Tower's single point of contact coordinating internal stakeholders to ensure operational excellence and successful customer implementations.- Own and develop relationships with strategic customers, acting as their strategic primary point of contact- Lead through influence rather than hierarchy, bringing the right people together across DSV to turn customer needs into action- Translate customer requirements into sustainable logistics solutions and improvement initiatives- Lead customer governance, including monthly and quarterly business reviews- Rate management (tender, new lanes, communicate/negotiate/implement rate update/changes)- Responsible for sustainable and profitable customer solutions or driving customer profitability- Monitor KPIs, operational performance and service levels, turning insight into action- Coordinate escalations and drive structural corrective actions- Identify opportunities that strengthen customer retention, continuous improvement and business growth- Balance customer expectations with operational feasibility and commercial objectives.Education & Experience:Ideally, you bring:Grow through ownership and influenceYou will join the Contract Management team within the Road Control Tower organisation, which serves as the strategic customer interface for some of DSV's most important Road Logistics customers.This is an opportunity to expand your scope through international customer exposure, cross-functional collaboration and real accountability. You will have the freedom to influence solutions, challenge constructively and help shape both the customer experience and DSV’s performance.What you bring:You combine strong customer focus with commercial awareness and the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments.We are looking for someone with:- Several years (5-10 years) of relevant experience in transport, logistics, supply chain, customer solutions, account management, or contract management- Strong knowledge of Road Freight operations and international transport networks- Experience managing strategic customer relationships or portfolios- The ability to influence stakeholders at different organisational levels- Strong analytical skills and confidence working with KPIs, performance metrics and operational data- Experience driving continuous improvement- A solution-oriented mindset with the confidence to challenge constructively- Strong Excel and data interpretation capabilities- Excellent communication skills in English.Ready to shape what’s next?If you want to take ownership of strategic customer partnerships and turn insights into operational and commercial impact, we would like to hear from you.The position can be based in Germany, the Netherlands or Poland.Your Contact:David MillerP&O Talent Acquisition Partnerkarriere@de.dsv.comPlease apply with your complete application documents via Employee Central.Please submit your complete application documents. To do so, create a profile, save it, and then click “Apply” again at the end.People with severe disabilities and those with equal status will be given preferential consideration if they are equally qualified.- Benefits may vary depending on location or division.DSV – Global Transport and LogisticsWas bewegt dich?Bei DSV bewegen wir mehr als nur Güter. Wir bewegen Karrieren, Ambitionen und Chancen.Mit rund 150.000 Kolleg:innen in über 90 Ländern sind wir weltweit führend in der Transport- und Logistikbranche. Doch was uns wirklich stark macht, sind die Menschen, die unsere Dienstleistungen und Lösungen jeden Tag mit Leben füllen. Ob im operativen Bereich oder in der Zentrale – jede Rolle trägt dazu bei, dass Lieferketten funktionieren und unsere Welt in Bewegung bleibt.Bei uns wirst du Teil eines Teams, in dem du Verantwortung übernimmst, eigene Ideen einbringst und Entscheidungen triffst, die wirklich etwas bewirken. Es ist ein Ort, an dem Menschen, Karrieren und Ideen vorankommen. Wir setzen auf transparente Kommunikation, echte Zusammenarbeit und ein Umfeld, in dem wir uns gegenseitig unterstützen, herausfordern und gemeinsam Erfolge feiern.Start here. Go anywhereDas ist unser Versprechen von Bewegung. Ein Versprechen, dass deine Arbeit wertgeschätzt wird und dein Beitrag wichtig ist. Und deine Karriere sich genau so entwickeln kann, wie du es dir wünschst.Wenn du etwas bewegen, deine Karriere vorantreiben und Teil von etwas Größerem sein möchtest – dann bist du bei DSV genau richtig.Besuche dsv.com (https://www.dsv.com/) und folge uns auf LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/dsv) , Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/dsv_global/) und Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/dsv.global) .#StartHereGoAnywhere #LifeAtDSV
